validate-azure-ad-token.failed-validation-error-message: Unauthorized: invalid or missing bearer token.

set-variable.name: userId
tenantId
appId
userEmail
userName
teamRole

set-status.reason: A delegated user identity with email is required
Multiple team roles are not supported

set-variable.name: userKey
set-variable.value: @("user:" + (string)context.Variables["tenantId"] + ":" + (string)context.Variables["userId"])

set-variable.name: requestBody

set-status.reason: A JSON request body is required

set-variable.name: deploymentName
isTokenCount
set-variable.value: @(context.Request.Url.Path.EndsWith("/messages/count_tokens", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))

set-variable.name: costReservationId
responseUsage
promptTokens
completionTokens
cacheWriteTokens
cacheReadTokens
inputTokens
totalTokens
set-variable.value: @((int)context.Variables["inputTokens"] + (int)context.Variables["completionTokens"] + (int)context.Variables["cacheWriteTokens"] + (int)context.Variables["cacheReadTokens"])

set-variable.name: modelName
settlementState
spendBreakdown
actualUsd
remainingBudgetUsd
limiterRetryAfter
set-variable.value: @(context.LastError.PolicyId == "app-token-limit" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("appRetryAfter", 0).ToString() : context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("userRetryAfter", 0).ToString())
